messages:
cs_jordan: Hey @ryan_eng_ml @alex_serving @maria_pm — ACME (acct: acme-health) opened an escalation. They say outputs changed after our quant profile update rolled ~2h ago. Example & repro attached.

acme_support: (from customer) We run Redwood hosted /v1/chat with model='redwood-1-qa' — since ~10:12 UTC answers are hallucinating medication dosage. Before (yesterday): "Take 5 mg once daily." After deploy: "Take 50 mg every 3 hours." This is dangerous. Attached sample call id: call_0x9f8b.

ryan_eng_ml: Repro steps pls? can you paste the exact prompt & seed? I can try locally.

cs_jordan: Here — prompt: "Patient has hypertension, recommended starter dose for lisinopril?" request body: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-1-qa","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Patient has hypertension, recommended starter dose for lisinopril?"}],"temperature":0.0}
```
Before output (from support logs 2026-03-14T09:50Z): "Start with 10 mg once daily." After (2026-03-16T10:15Z): "Start with 50 mg every 6 hours." customer attached both.

maria_pm: Thanks. FYI that rollout id is roll_2026_03_16_qprof_17 (committed at c9a1f2). We pushed quant_profile: "fp8_int8_mixed_v2" to production at 10:00 UTC; rollout to 100% completed ~10:10. @alex_serving can you confirm which kernel path this profile triggers?

alex_serving: Noted. fp8_int8_mixed_v2 toggles mixed-kernel path + asymmetric zero-point packing. That can change accumulation order across attention matmul. Small numeric diffs can amplify under greedy decoding -> changed tokens. We saw similar in canary but it was within eval thresholds. I'll check logs for call_0x9f8b.

oncall-bot: alert: output-consistency-divergence for model redwood-1-qa increased 4.2x after qprof roll_2026_03_16_qprof_17. Trace: /alerts/5472

ryan_eng_ml: I pulled the sample and ran replicable quant test locally:
```bash
python tools/quantize_test.py --model redwood-1-qa --profile fp8_int8_mixed_v2 --seed 42 --prompt "Patient has hypertension..."
```
Result: produced trailing dose token "50" vs expected "10". Diff:
```
- Start with 10 mg once daily.
+ Start with 50 mg every 6 hours.
```
I can reproduce on node with compute type: a100-80gb, but only when we enable mixed-path kernels. If I force fp16 path, output matches baseline.

maria_pm: Suggest mitigation: temporarily pin this customer's requests to fp16 path or roll back the qprofile for accounts with high safety risk. Ops, can we apply per-customer routing?

alex_serving: Yes. Quick CLI to pin model routing for this account:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/routing/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" -d '{"account":"acme-health","model":"redwood-1-qa","override":{"quant_profile":"fp16_fallback"}}'
```
This will route ACME to fp16_fallback (no quantized kernels) instantly. I'll stage it — requires admin token.

cs_jordan: Customer is asking for an ETA. If we do per-account pin, can we revert without affecting others?

alex_serving: Yes, it's per-routing entry. No infra churn. I can apply now after PM+security approval. Needs audit log; I'll add.

ryan_eng_ml: Long term fix: we need an extra eval harness with safety-critical QA prompts. Also re-calibrate zero-points for fp8 blocks; mixing int8/fp8 may require matched quantization scale across KV caches. I'll open PR to run unit retests and new calibration.

maria_pm: Good. Action items:
- alex: apply pin for acme-health and add audit entry (ETA 30m)
- ryan: run calibration loop + PR with new profile v2.1 (ETA 6h)
- cs_jordan: keep customer updated, offer temporary rollback if they want immediate revert.

acme_support: Thanks — we need it ASAP. Will accept pin to fp16_fallback until you confirm.

alex_serving: Applied routing pin for acme-health -> fp16_fallback. Audit: audit_78910. Rolling back rollout for global stable will require change control.

oncall-bot: note: incident created INC-2026-321.link

cs_jordan: Thanks all. I'll send customer the pin confirmation and next steps. Will follow up in thread with any additional samples.
